# CONFORMANCE

The conformance ID register. Every test name ends in its ID; a test whose
ID is not listed here fails `cargo xtask check-model`, and so does an ID
listed here with no scenario and no test (`CM-02`).

The three honesty levels (R2):

| Level | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `some-true` | A fact reproduced from an authority. **Not established here.** |
| `build` | Constructed here and validated against its oracle. Evidence, not a proof. |
| `open` | Measured and reported. **Never asserted.** |

`cargo xtask audit-limits` fails if any code path returns an error the
model does not sanction.

## prism

| ID | Level | Statement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PM-01` | `build` | The Prism answers a request naming a known facet with exactly that facet's decision of the rest, and refuses every other request |
| `PM-02` | `build` | The Boundary denies every move while halted and every move to GitHub or the hosted verifier, never allows detected, restricted or identifying data out, and never sends outbound without the owner's approval |
| `PM-03` | `build` | Learning confirms or rejects a belief only on the owner's signal, holds a confirmed or rejected belief against every other signal, and never raises a weight above 15 or lowers it below 1 |
| `PM-04` | `build` | Chronology never names an Allen relation that the two intervals' endpoints contradict, and never calls two well-formed intervals malformed |

## vault

| ID | Level | Statement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `VS-01` | `build` | The vault keeps a value only when the Boundary and the proved store decision allow it: sealed under a non-extractable device key, filed under an address that re-derives from the value, and as a keyed hash only for card or restricted data |
| `VS-02` | `build` | The vault restores a value only when the proved restore decision allows it: a flipped bit, a swapped object, an unknown envelope or a lost key ring is refused, and nothing is deleted |
